observations: Black domestic sewing machine head with gold decorative decals.
The brand 'TWO LION' is printed on the machine arm and the base plate.
The machine is mounted on a brown wooden table with a single drawer on the right side.
A gold 'TWO LION' brand decal is visible on the front edge of the wooden table.
The table is supported by a dark metal treadle stand with a foot pedal and large drive wheel.
An electric motor is attached to the rear of the machine head with a power cord.
The leather drive belt for the treadle mechanism appears to be missing.
The wooden table surface shows visible wear and chipping along the front edges.
